about: What tools/build_latest.ps1 builds: the newest playable state. The orchestrator keeps this current as branches land; every listed merge is checked to be conflict-free when it changes. Branch names are without origin/; paths are relative to unity/.
contents: The test-range beta at physics model 79, from the build line (it holds the player): Explore opens the friend's farmland in noclip, from its start point in the village, with the feed and OSD (Train still flies the test range until W3) (W1, D-088, D-092); the sim's lag is capped: a late step costs at most one PAL field, never a growing delay (L5), and the step timer logs every step's cost (L4); no crash on quit after the feed has drawn the farmland (W1); the climb after a pitch-back settles about twice as fast (the rotors' edgewise flow; cruise throttle 5-7 points lower) (D-087); the fiber's chain solved by Newton, so no false tension snaps: cruise to 100 km/h and ordinary turns keep the line whole, sharp turns and reverses still cut (D-087); the line leaves a 27.5 deg bent nozzle from a see-through canister (D-086); airmode off and the ESC's brake off (D-086); the motors' heat and dirt; a lost prop flips, a lost blade shakes; R restarts at once, a new flight builds in about 30-40 ms; the house's shape checks and the fiber's checks faster (the lag near the first house cut, not yet gone); a bent leg's skid drawn where the physics has it; plus everything before: legs that set, crack and break, props at rest, the motor's bell and shaft, the fiber's contacts and Betaflight's failsafe, the dropouts without the black sticks, the analog feed, OSD, R, C, X, V, pause, the summary and the flight log. Not yet: per-flight balance offsets, the arm break re-graded on sourced data, the fiber tearing at the hole's edge on a reverse, soft wires, vegetation on the legs and props.
